if.test: pStartDate != null and pStartDate != '' and pEndDate != null and pEndDate != ''

where.if: AND ( C.ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND C.ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tShpShipCheck C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = C.ShopCode

SELECT C.ShipCheckNo, C.ShopCode, S.ShopName AS ShopName, C.ShipCheckDesc, CAST(C.ShipCheckDate AS CHAR) AS ShipCheckDate, C.OrderCount, C.PrintCount, C.State, C.Remark, C.RegistId, C.RegistName, CAST(C.RegistDate AS CHAR) AS RegistDate, C.ChangeId, C.ChangeName, CAST(C.ChangeDate AS CHAR) AS ChangeDate FROM shopwizard.tShpShipCheck C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = C.ShopCode WHERE C.ShipCheckNo = #{shipCheckNo}

SELECT SD.ShopCode AS shopCode, MAX(S.ShopName) AS shopName, COUNT(DISTINCT SD.OrderNo) AS orderCount FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SD LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = SD.ShopCode WHERE SD.ShipCheckDate = #{shipCheckDate} AND SD.ShopCode IS NOT NULL AND SD.ShopCode <> '' GROUP BY SD.ShopCode
